<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
update_option( 'blogname', 'Toko Nusantara' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array( 'skipped' => true ) );
update_option( 'woocommerce_currency', 'IDR' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_currency_pos', 'left' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_price_thousand_sep', '.' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_price_decimal_sep', ',' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_price_num_decimals', '0' );
if ( method_exists( 'WC_Install', 'create_pages' ) ) { WC_Install::create_pages(); }
update_option( 'oow_settings', array( 'phone' => '6280000000000', 'show_on_shop' => 1 ) );
foreach ( array( array( 'Batik Parang Shirt', '185000', 'BTK-001' ), array( 'Tenun Ikat Scarf', '120000', 'TNN-002' ) ) as $row ) {
	$p = new WC_Product_Simple();
	$p->set_name( $row[0] );
	$p->set_regular_price( $row[1] );
	$p->set_sku( $row[2] );
	$p->set_status( 'publish' );
	$p->save();
}
$size = new WC_Product_Attribute();
$size->set_name( 'Size' );
$size->set_options( array( 'S', 'M', 'L' ) );
$size->set_visible( true );
$size->set_variation( true );
$dress = new WC_Product_Variable();
$dress->set_name( 'Kebaya Dress' );
$dress->set_sku( 'KBY-003' );
$dress->set_attributes( array( $size ) );
$dress->set_status( 'publish' );
$dress->save();
foreach ( array( 'S' => '250000', 'M' => '265000', 'L' => '280000' ) as $label => $price ) {
	$v = new WC_Product_Variation();
	$v->set_parent_id( $dress->get_id() );
	$v->set_attributes( array( 'size' => $label ) );
	$v->set_regular_price( $price );
	$v->set_sku( 'KBY-003-' . $label );
	$v->save();
}
WC_Product_Variable::sync( $dress->get_id() );
flush_rewrite_rules();
